Package com.irurueta.authserver.serviceclient.infrastructure.resourceserver

Class PrincipalMapper

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.serviceclient.infrastructure.resourceserver.PrincipalMapper
@Component public class PrincipalMapper extends Object
Builds the principals the authorized client manager caches tokens under. There is no security context in the service client, so every call names its principal.

    • user

      public org.springframework.security.core.Authentication user(String subjectToken)
      Builds the principal of a user whose token is exchanged. Its name is the sub claim of the token when it is a readable JWT, followed by a digest of the whole token: the claim is not verified here (the authorization server does that), so the digest keeps two different tokens from ever sharing a cached exchange.
      Parameters:
      subjectToken - access token of the user.
      Returns:
      the principal, whose principal object is the token, as the exchange provider expects.

    • subjectOf

      private static String subjectOf(String token)
      Reads the sub claim of a JWT without verifying it.
      Parameters:
      token - the token.
      Returns:
      the claim, or "user" when the token is opaque or has no subject.
